name: Mount Lethe
title: Mount Lethe
summary: One of the three mountains where a Hellfire spawns: the Mount Lethe Hellfire appears in the crater at 34.4S 84.9W when the Tenkarrdun Hellfire is killed (Lady Aerfalle Quest). In the kit a lava plateau (z 70) north of the volcano holds the Magma Tubes cave hut and a field of erupting geysers, 11-second firespurts and yellow steam vents. To the south-east the volcano rises to z 148 around a crater floor at z 122, its north-west rim beaded with 92 glowing red lava emitters and orange embers in the bowl.

shots.standingOrder: Spiral down clockwise over the north rim into Mount Lethe's crater, 95 m to 52 m out and 70 m to 34 m above its floor, the lava glow backlit by the low sun; keep 8 m above the rim.
shots.notes: Signature view: the drone spirals down clockwise over the north rim into Mount Lethe's crater, where the Mount Lethe Hellfire spawns. It moves from 95 m to 52 m out and from 70 m to 34 m above the crater floor (z 122). The glowing red lava beads (92 emitters) on the rim and the orange embers in the bowl are backlit by the low golden sun ahead-right. The southern landblocks (y < 16128) are not in the kit, so the spiral stays north. shots.standingOrder: Lock off low on the steaming plateau east of the firespurts and geysers, looking west into the golden sun as they erupt; nothing moves but the fire and steam.
shots.notes: Flames and steam: the lens is locked off 3.2 m above the steaming lava plateau, 24 m east-north-east of the geyser field, and looks west-south-west into the low golden sun. Ten 11-second firespurts, five geysers and the yellow side steam erupt backlit in front of the Magma Tubes cave hut. Nothing moves but the fire.
